#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Read version.json, bump patch by 1, write back, and emit tag.txt
VERSION_FILE="version.json"
TAG_FILE="tag.txt"

# Parse fields using python3 for robust JSON handling
read -r major minor patch < <(python3 -c '
import json
v=json.load(open("'"$VERSION_FILE"'"))
print(v["major"], v["minor"], v["patch"]+1)
')

# Write bumped version back to version.json
python3 -c '
import json
v=json.load(open("'"$VERSION_FILE"'"))
v["patch"]+=1
json.dump(v, open("'"$VERSION_FILE"'","w"))
print(json.dumps(v))
'

# Write tag file with v<major>.<minor>.<patch>
printf 'v%s.%s.%s' "$major" "$minor" "$patch" > "$TAG_FILE"

echo "Bumped to v${major}.${minor}.${patch}"

</parameter>
